name: og-operating-window
title: Operating Window: Can Pore and Membrane Concentration Rescue the Pool?
primary_limitation: A simultaneous operating window exists but only in a NARROW corner at the upper edge of defensible small-molecule thermophoresis - S_T at the ~1e-2/K small-molecule ceiling AND high thermal gradient (~50 K) AND high DIC (~20 mM) together (overlap volume ~0.11 of the defensible grid). The canonical mid-point (S_T 5e-3) stays sub-consumable. Whether C2-C3 organics actually reach S_T ~1e-2 at the vent is the unmeasured quantity the verdict hinges on.
key_assumptions: Soret coefficient of the small C2-C3 precursors is not independently sourced; it is swept as the pivotal uncertain parameter over the small-molecule range [1e-3, 1e-1]/K. The trap's 0.10/K default is the large-biomolecule value (Baaske's 10^8); using it for small precursors would falsely rescue the pool, so it is never pinned. The S_T -> enrichment framework is Baaske-2007 / Mast-Braun-2010; the small-molecule endpoints are the swept range, and measuring S_T(C2-C3) is the discriminating experiment.

Product-pool enrichment: the thermophoretic trap concentrates the functional precursor pool by its solved enrichment factor at a single representative aggregate small-molecule S_T. Per-species Soret fractionation (different precursors enrich differently - see og-spatial-concentration) is not resolved here.

Membrane retention is the real ProtocellAssembly (Jordan-2019-calibrated) retention, applied as an effective washout reduction k_wash*(1-retention) on og-precursor-pool's reactor; CO2 is never enriched past its DIC solubility (a physical ceiling, not a free knob).
Overlap is reported as a volume (fraction of the defensible parameter space reaching a consumable pool) with per-regime failure reasons - never as an origin-of-life probability.
claim: The downstream pore-enrichment + membrane-retention machinery can rescue og-precursor-pool's nanomolar functional pool to a consumable (~uM) concentration, but only in a narrow corner at the upper edge of defensible small-molecule thermophoresis (S_T ~1e-2/K ceiling + high thermal gradient + high DIC together; overlap volume ~0.11 of the defensible grid, 0.42 overall). The canonical mid-point does not clear it. The rescue hinges on the Soret coefficient of the C2-C3 precursors (the dominant parameter by Morris), so measuring S_T(C2-C3) at the vent gradient is the discriminating experiment.
question: Do the vent, pore, and membrane regimes share a simultaneous operating window, or only a transport-connected sequence of microenvironments?
hypothesis: Propagating the calibrated vent posterior through the network, pore and membrane regimes leaves a nonempty overlap only under transport coupling; where the successful conditions do not overlap, an explicit spatial/temporal transfer is required and transport survival must be tested.
experiment: Propagate og-precursor-pool's real precursor yield vectors through the real FiPy thermophoretic pore (product-pool enrichment at swept small-molecule Soret) and the real ProtocellAssembly membrane (retention -> reduced washout); sweep (soret x delta_T x DIC); report the overlap volume reaching a consumable pool, per-regime failure reasons, the Morris parameter-sensitivity ranking, and the single most informative discriminating experiment.
primary_output: Overlap volume (fraction of the defensible parameter space reaching a consumable ~uM functional pool), per-regime failure reasons, the parameter-sensitivity ranking, and the single most informative discriminating experiment.

upstream_state_consumed.provides: the real functional precursor yield vectors from og-precursor-pool - the ~nM C2-C3 pool this study tries to rescue - consumed via its PrecursorPoolProcess run under membrane-reduced washout
the calibrated vent posterior (feed + DIC window) to propagate

proposed_controls: report overlap as a volume, NOT as an origin-of-life probability

arms.concept_role: og-precursor-pool's real nM precursor pool propagated through the real pore (FiPy Soret trap) + real membrane (ProtocellAssembly retention), swept over the defensible operating-window parameters.

behavior_tests.name: pore-trap-enrichment-real
behavior_tests.description: The real FiPy thermophoretic trap produces a genuine enrichment factor (>1) at the canonical thermal gradient and a defensible small-molecule Soret coefficient; a no-gradient control gives ~1.

pass_if.detail: real trap enriches (>1) at the defensible operating point

behavior_tests.name: membrane-retention-real
behavior_tests.description: The real ProtocellAssembly membrane retains internal chemistry at a viable level (Jordan-2019-calibrated vent retention ~0.9) while staying permeable (access > 0).

behavior_tests.name: rescue-requires-both-levers
behavior_tests.description: Cross-run: the enriched+retained pool with BOTH levers exceeds pore-only (no membrane) and membrane-only (no gradient) - each regime contributes - graded by sims/run.py.

measure.detail: both-levers vs pore-only vs membrane-only enriched pool

pass_if.detail: both levers needed; each single regime is lower

behavior_tests.name: operating-window-reaches-consumable
behavior_tests.description: DIAGNOSTIC (the qualifying test): at a defensible small-molecule Soret, does the enriched + retained functional pool reach a downstream-consumable ~uM concentration? It does not - this FAIL is the quantitative backbone of the qualified rescue verdict.

findings.statement: The pore enrichment is the genuine FiPy thermophoretic accumulation column (enrichment = solved base/top ratio), ~1 in a no-gradient control and rising with the thermal gradient and Soret coefficient - the real Baaske trap, not an invented concentration factor.

evidence.observed: enrichment factor > 1 at delta_T 30 K, defensible S_T; ~1 at delta_T ~ 0

findings.explanation: beta = geom*soret*dT*Pe_conv/width; FiPy solves 0 = D c'' - D*beta c'; enrichment = exp(beta*pore_length).

findings.evidence_basis_note: Retention is the real ProtocellAssembly (Jordan-2019) output at vent conditions; the ~30x pool lift it buys (via reduced washout) is a model output, not fit to a target.
findings.statement: The real membrane retains chemistry at the Jordan-2019 vent level (retention ~0.905, access ~0.997, viable), lifting the functional pool ~30x (from ~4e-10 to ~1.2e-8 M C) via reduced effective washout.
findings.explanation: k_wash_eff = k_wash*(1-retention); lower washout raises the steady-state pool, but only ~1.5 orders - far short of the ~4 orders the nanomolar pool needs to reach uM.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The enriched+retained pool across the sweep is a model prediction (not fit to any target); the overlap volume and the corner that clears uM are predicted results.
findings.statement: A simultaneous operating window exists but is narrow: the enriched+retained functional pool reaches the consumable ~uM threshold in ~11% of the defensible-Soret grid (42% of the full grid), only at the favorable corner - S_T at the 1e-2/K small-molecule ceiling with a high thermal gradient (~50 K) and high DIC (~20 mM). The canonical mid-point (S_T 5e-3, dT 30 K, 2 mM) stays at ~3e-8 M, sub-consumable.

evidence.observed: overlap_volume_defensible ~0.11 (all ~0.42); best defensible enriched ~6.3e-6 M; canonical ~2.9e-8 M (FAIL vs 1e-6)

findings.explanation: Enrichment is exponential in beta ~ soret*dT and the C2+ pool scales super-linearly with DIC, so only the joint upper corner of the defensible box clears uM; a single-point read at mid parameters would have mis-called it a flat refutation - the sweep is what finds the corner.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The Soret crossover where the window opens is extrapolated from the trap physics over the swept S_T range; S_T for C2-C3 organics is not independently measured (hence the discriminating experiment).
findings.statement: The window opens only at S_T ~1e-2/K (the small-molecule ceiling); nothing below it clears uM. Morris sensitivity ranks the Soret coefficient the dominant parameter by far (mu* ~2.5 vs delta_T ~1.7, DIC ~1.0, membrane mix ~0), so measuring S_T of the C2-C3 precursors at the vent thermal gradient is the single most informative experiment.

evidence.observed: Soret crossover ~1e-2/K; Morris ranking soret_coeff > delta_T > feed_CO2 > mix_fraction

findings.explanation: Enrichment is exponential in beta ~ soret*dT, so S_T spans many orders of enrichment across the swept range; it dwarfs delta_T, DIC and membrane mix in the Morris screening. The rescue hinges on a single unmeasured quantity.

findings.statement: Both regimes contribute: the enriched+retained pool exceeds pore-only (no membrane) and membrane-only (no gradient) at the canonical point; the transport-decoupled null (no membrane) is lower still. Neither lever alone suffices - the narrow window needs the pore gradient and membrane retention together.

evidence.observed: both-levers ~2.9e-8 M > pore-only and > membrane-only (canonical, defensible mid Soret)

findings.explanation: Removing the pore gradient or the membrane each lowers the pool; both are necessary for the corner window, so the rescue is a genuinely joint pore+membrane effect, not either regime alone.
